about.text: Hard yellow cheese made from cows' milk. Named after the town of Korycin.

sources.text: PGI (Reg. 728/2012); EU single document: fresh 2-4 days, aged 5-14 days, mature over 14 days (no upper limit, so max 60 is my estimate); originally raw whole cow's milk, pasteurised allowed since 2023. Firmness class assumed semi-hard, was hard
